name: wpf-minimized-increment
description: Launch the WPF counter fixture fresh, minimize it, and deliver one background semantic click while the window stays iconic (the local patch's contract).
notes: Composed: steps come from the wpf-minimize and wpf-increment sub-recipes, in that order (included steps run first), and this file owns the launch, the target and the expected value. One command launches a fresh fixture (counter 0, state file overwritten) through launch_app, then replays the sub-recipes. The launch pins the pid/window_id it created unless --no-launch is given, because a stale instance shares the title; --var expected=<counter+1> reruns it against a live window. Paths use %USERPROFILE% so the recipe is not tied to one machine's user directory. See recipes/README.md for the composition rules.
